meta.name: team-communication-protocols
meta.description: Structured messaging protocols for agent team communication including message type selection, plan approval, shutdown procedures, and anti-patterns to avoid. Use this skill when establishing communication norms for a newly spawned team, when deciding whether to send a direct message or a broadcast, when a team-lead needs to review and approve an implementer's plan before work begins, when orchestrating a graceful team shutdown after all tasks are complete, or when debugging why teammates are not coordinating correctly at integration points.

copy.tagline: 规范智能体团队的沟通与协作流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发多智能体系统,需要统一团队通信规则
copy.fit_line_en: For you if building multi-agent systems and need clear messaging protocols.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 和队友通信时会按协议行事:默认只给具体队友发私信,只有牵动全体才广播;实施者的计划需先获批才动工;任务收尾时按步骤逐个关闭队友并清理资源。
howto.when: 当你要为新团队建立沟通规矩、需要审批队友提交的计划、或所有活干完后让团队优雅下线时,它就会介入。

say.text: 给我们团队定个消息规范吧:什么情况用私信,什么情况广播
say.note: Claude 会生成通信规则并应用

say.text: 请把「共享类型已更新」广播给全体成员
say.note: 会以 broadcast 类型发送给所有队友

say.text: 任务都完成了,请你按协议关闭团队并清理资源
say.note: 会发起逐个 shutdown_request 流程

howto.what_en: Claude follows a teammate messaging protocol: direct messages by default, broadcasts only for team-wide impacts, plans need approval before work, and graceful shutdown with cleanup when tasks finish.
howto.when_en: Triggered when setting norms for a new team, when a lead reviews an implementer's plan, or after all tasks are done to shut down the team gracefully.

say_en.text: Define our team messaging norms: when to use direct messages vs broadcasts.
say_en.note: Claude creates and applies communication rules.

say_en.text: Broadcast 'Shared types updated' to all teammates.
say_en.note: Sends a broadcast to every member.

say_en.text: All tasks are done. Shut down the team and clean up resources per protocol.
